722590101.text: There are two rows of text on this headstone. The first row is in the script of Byakuyakoku and is unintelligible.

722590102.text: The second row is in the common script, and it goes as follows:

722590103.text: "Here lies Orupeusu no Mikoto, who was skilled in music as a youth, specializing in playing the lyre. His voice was so lovely that even the very earth would be moved."
